detail.longDescription: I have an AWS SSM Document, and when I run it with aws ssm send-command it fails on the parameter validation. I pass the arguments in JSON. These are the input parameters that fail. Expected format according to the document's spec: { "Foo": "foo-value", "Bar": "bar-value", "Baz": 42 } I store the parameters in a file input.json to avoid PowerShell escaping issues. The document: --- schemaVersion: "2.2" description: "Test parameters" parameters: Foo: type: "String" description: "" Bar: type: "String" description: "" Baz: type: "Integer" description: "" mainSteps: - action: "aws:runPowerShellScript" name: "RunCommands" inputs: runCommand: - '$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"' - 'Write-Output "Foo: $($env:Foo)"' - 'Write-Output "Bar: $($env:Bar)"' - 'Write-Output "Baz: $($env:Baz)"' Command: aws ssm send-command --document-name "Parameter-test" --targets "Key=tag:Name,Values=Foobar" --parameters 'file://input.json Error: aws: [ERROR]: An error occurred (ParamValidation): Parameter validation failed: Invalid type for parameter Parameters.Foo, value: foo-value, type: <class 'str'>, valid types: <class 'list'>, <class 'tuple'> Invalid type for parameter Parameters.Bar, value: bar-value, type: <class 'str'>, valid types: <class 'list'>, <class 'tuple'> Invalid type for parameter Parameters.Baz, value: 42, type: <class 'int'>, valid types: <class 'list'>, <class 'tuple'>
